deathSays.line: Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.

🔥 The fire settles. Sourav has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A crow that watches too long and blinks too little — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 50s, with restless hands mutters "We've been walking past those." the person in their 40s says quietly "And you're still standing."
